_source.origin: GIRO/DIDBase (giro.uml.edu) ionosonde network and CEDAR (cedarweb.vsp.ucar.edu) observatory directory.

ionosonde.name: Millstone Hill ISR
ionosonde.notes: Incoherent scatter radar; ionospheric storms and TEC monitoring

ionosonde.name: Arecibo Observatory (legacy)
ionosonde.notes: Former world's largest ISR; ionospheric heating experiments; 305m dish

ionosonde.name: Jicamarca Radio Observatory
ionosonde.notes: Equatorial ISR; studies equatorial spread-F and electrojet

ionosonde.name: EISCAT Tromsø
ionosonde.notes: European ISR; auroral zone ionosphere; heating facility (HEATING)

ionosonde.name: HAARP (Gakona)
ionosonde.notes: High-frequency Active Auroral Research Program; ionospheric heater; 3.6 MW ERP

ionosonde.name: Sondrestrom ISR
ionosonde.notes: Polar cap incoherent scatter radar; cusp region studies

ionosonde.name: Kharkov ISR
ionosonde.notes: Eastern European ISR; 25m dish; ionospheric irregularities

ionosonde.name: MU Radar (Shigaraki)
ionosonde.notes: Middle and Upper atmosphere radar; mesosphere-stratosphere-troposphere

ionosonde.name: Resolute Bay ISR

ionosonde.name: Poker Flat ISR (PFISR)

ionosonde.name: SURA Ionospheric Heating Facility

gnss_station.name: Cachoeira Paulista Digisonde
gnss_station.notes: Equatorial anomaly region; F-region bubble detection; South Atlantic Anomaly

gnss_station.name: Ascension Island Ionosonde

gnss_station.name: Darwin Ionosonde
gnss_station.notes: Equatorial region; Appleton anomaly crest monitoring

gnss_station.name: Learmonth Ionosonde
gnss_station.notes: Australian reference ionosonde; feeds ASWFC space weather forecasts
